text:
We often talk about the joy of building a personal knowledge base, but we rarely discuss the hidden maintenance tax. Every note you capture is a micro-debt you eventually have to pay back. 

If you don't have a system for pruning, linking, or updating old thoughts, your digital garden quickly turns into a digital landfill. The cost isn't just the time spent organizing; it's the cognitive load of navigating a graveyard of outdated ideas that no longer serve you.
